text:
julie: Heads-up — we're moving the all-hands up 10 mins. AV says the room recorder is dropping frames. Can ops grab a backup laptop + HDMI switch? We need a fallback that preserves slide sync.
will: On it. I'm bringing @ryan's MacBook and an HDMI splitter. If OBS dies we'll do Zoom native recording.
ryan: cool. Also can someone confirm the battery on the wireless mic? One of the stage mics is cutting out.
ops-bot: Encoder alert at 08:12:43 — dropped frames >5% (obs-encoder-3). Auto-restart scheduled.
will: restarted encoder, monitoring. :white_check_mark:
kate: if encoder repeats, fallback plan: use local iso on MacBook + simultaneous Zoom recording. Slide deck link in chat?
maria: uploading slides now -> https://drive.redwood.ai/slides/allhands-mar.json
julie: thanks. @erica — can we compress the roadmap Q&A to 20 mins? We lost 10 mins with the mic swap.
erica: fine — move open Q&A to after product updates, but keep 2 mins for live demos. Also please capture any unanswered questions in #all-hands-q.
sam: note for stream: set bitrate to 4.5k to avoid straining the encoder. Command we used: 
```
obs-cli --set --stream-bitrate 4500k && obs-cli --restart-encoder
```
will: running that now. Also toggled prefix caching on the service to reduce token bursts for demo.
ryan: mic battery replaced, trying a soundcheck in 2 mins.
julie: quick cue: hosts, please drop 1-sentence intros when you come on — keeps timings tight.
ops-bot: Recorder local-iso started on will-macbook. File path: /recordings/allhands-4087654321.mp4
maria: slides uploaded and linked in the calendar. :rocket:
erica: thank you team. if anything else pops, post here — we'll be ready to pivot.
will: final: Zoom fallback pinned and recording set. Ready on my end. :thumbsup:
